data.title: Speeding fine – €98.50, 1 point
data.summary: The Landkreis Beispielheide fines office issued a fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid) dated 13 October 2025 for driving 23 km/h over the limit on 21 September 2025. The total is €98.50 plus 1 point in the driving-fitness register.
data.explanation: You are accused of speeding 23 km/h over the 70 km/h limit outside a built-up area. You may file an objection (Einspruch) in writing or on record at the Landkreis; the app shows the deadline, counted from delivery. If you don't object, the notice becomes final and the total is due two weeks after that. Pay with the file number (Aktenzeichen) as reference. If you object, the court is not bound by the fine amount and could set a different one. Consider professional advice if unsure.
